table.retrieve:
SELECT	
	AliasName=I.CustomICode, 
	icode=I.icode,
	Item=I.Name, 
	active=CASE i.active WHEN 1 THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END,
	GroupCode=GR.Code,
	GroupName=GR.Name,
	GD.Batch, 
	Expiry=CONVERT(varchar(12), GD.Expiry, 103), 
	Stock=SUM(GD.CurrQty), 
	PackUnits=MAX(I.PackUnits),
	Locked=MAX(GD.Locked),
	LockReason = (SELECT LR.Name FROM LockReason LR WHERE LR.LockReasonCode=MAX(GD.LockReasonCode)),
/*	Rate = 	ISNULL((SELECT MAX(CASE P.UpdateAvgPriceWithNetRate WHEN 'Y' THEN D.NetRate - (D.UnitSalesTax + (((D.looseQty + D.PackQty) * D.PurPrice * (1 - D.DiscPerc * 0.01) * D.GSTPerc * 0.01) / (D.looseQty + D.PackQty + D.BonusQty) )) ELSE D.NetRate END) 
				FROM PurDetail D, PurLedger P
				WHERE P.PurInvCode = D.PurInvcode AND D.PurUTN IS NOT NULL AND 
					D.ICode=GD.ICode AND D.Batch=GD.Batch AND D.Expiry=GD.Expiry AND 
					D.PurUTN IN 
						(SELECT UTN=MAX(DD.PurUtn) 
						FROM PurDetail DD 
						WHERE DD.ICode=D.ICode AND DD.Batch=D.Batch AND DD.Expiry=D.Expiry)), MAX(I.AvgPrice)),
*/
	Rate = 	ISNULL((SELECT MAX( ((D.NetRate - (D.UnitSalesTax + (((D.looseQty + D.PackQty) * D.PurPrice * (1 - D.DiscPerc * 0.01) * D.GSTPerc * 0.01) / (D.looseQty + D.PackQty + D.BonusQty) ))) / CASE WHEN P.PurCatCode > 2 THEN 1 ELSE CASE WHEN D.PackUnits > 0 THEN D.PackUnits ELSE 1 END END) ) 
				FROM PurDetail D, PurLedger P
				WHERE P.PurInvCode = D.PurInvcode AND D.PurUTN IS NOT NULL AND 
					D.ICode=GD.ICode AND D.Batch=GD.Batch AND D.Expiry=GD.Expiry AND 
					D.PurUTN IN 
						(SELECT UTN=MAX(DD.PurUtn) 
						FROM PurDetail DD 
						WHERE DD.ICode=D.ICode AND DD.Batch=D.Batch AND DD.Expiry=D.Expiry)), MAX(I.AvgPrice)),
	Tax = 	ISNULL((SELECT MAX( (D.UnitSalesTax + (((D.looseQty + D.PackQty) * D.PurPrice * (1 - D.DiscPerc * 0.01) * D.GSTPerc * 0.01) / (D.looseQty + D.PackQty + D.BonusQty))) / CASE WHEN P.PurCatCode > 2 THEN 1 ELSE CASE WHEN D.PackUnits > 0 THEN D.PackUnits ELSE 1 END END)
				FROM PurDetail D, PurLedger P
				WHERE P.PurInvCode = D.PurInvcode AND D.PurUTN IS NOT NULL AND 
					D.ICode=GD.ICode AND D.Batch=GD.Batch AND D.Expiry=GD.Expiry AND 
					D.PurUTN IN 
						(SELECT UTN=MAX(DD.PurUtn) 
						FROM PurDetail DD 
						WHERE DD.ICode=D.ICode AND DD.Batch=D.Batch AND DD.Expiry=D.Expiry)), 0)
FROM	
	ITEM I, 
	(SELECT Code=M.ManfCode, Name=M.Name
	FROM MANUFACTURER M
	WHERE :as_group = 'M' AND M.ManfCode IN (:ar_GroupCode)
	UNION ALL 
	SELECT Code=IC.ICatCode, Name=IC.Name
	FROM ItemCategory IC
	WHERE :as_group = 'C' AND IC.ICatCode IN (:ar_GroupCode)
	UNION ALL 
	SELECT Code=IC.ICCode, Name=IC.Name
	FROM ItemClass IC
	WHERE :as_group = 'L' AND IC.ICCode IN (:ar_GroupCode)
	UNION ALL 
	SELECT Code=IP.PackCode, Name=IP.Name
	FROM ItemPacking IP
	WHERE :as_group = 'P' AND IP.PackCode IN (:ar_GroupCode)) GR,
	GODOWNDETAIL GD, 
	Godown G
WHERE	
	CASE :as_group
		WHEN 'M' THEN I.ManfCode
		WHEN 'C' THEN I.ICatCode
		WHEN 'L' THEN I.ICCode
		WHEN 'P' THEN I.PackCode
	END = GR.Code AND
	I.Icode = GD.ICode AND
	GD.GCode = G.GCode
GROUP BY
	GR.Code,
	GR.Name,
	I.icode,
	GD.ICode,
	I.Name,
	I.CustomICode, 
	I.Active,
	GD.Batch,
	GD.Expiry
table.sort: groupname A, item A, batch A, expiry A
